name: Hope~ Symphony of Tomorrow
source:
Hope's story revolves around Aikawa Yusuke, a second year high school student at Shikaido High.
Until three years ago he never thought about leaving the place where he grow up and a house he had so far called home. Even if sometimes co-existing with is control maniac father wasn't an easy task it was nothing that he could not bare. However one fatidic day everything changed, an event that would happen that would affect everyone's lives at the Aikawa residence.

A dying wish. A promise made. A light that would fade out. A dream that would never come through.

That lake where once two close siblings shared their hopes and dreams would be the point where a page of Yusuke life would be torn apart. That tiny creature he held tightly on his back, was thanking him just a moment ago… but now she just remained motionless without making as much as a sound … he could not even feel the warmth of her breath on his neck anymore. The only thing he could feel was his own tears running down his face, those tears that could not wash away the guilt that weighted on his chest.

"Goodbye Karen…"

One year ago, Yusuke entered High School, joining Shikaido High leaving behind his town and family behind looking to start anew. He moved to a small apartment where he currently resides and that he currently pays by juggling part time jobs. Yusuke personality could be described as a laid back type of person, with a witty sense of humor, cynical and sarcastic at times.
A new journey will begin for him signaled by the start of a new school year. Crossing paths with other unique individuals, he will get into a crossroad and face hard decisions that might change not only his own future but of those whose life he will touch.

Will Yusuke be able to keep the promise he made to his sister three years ago, regaining something he lost in his past?
translation: 《Hope》的故事围绕着四海道高中的高二学生海川优介展开。直到三年前，他从未想过离开自己长大的地方和一直称之为家的房子。即使与控制狂父亲同住并不轻松，也不是他无法忍受的。然而在一个命运之日，一切都改变了——一个影响海川家所有人生活的事件发生了。一个临终的愿望。一个许下的承诺。一盏即将熄灭的灯。一个永远无法实现的梦想。那座曾经两个亲密的兄弟姐妹分享希望和梦想的湖泊，将成为优介人生被撕裂的地方。他紧紧背在背上的小小生命，刚才还在感谢他……但现在她只是静静地一动不动，连一声声响都没有……他甚至感觉不到她呼吸的温度了。他能感受到的只有从脸上流下的眼泪，那些无法洗去压在胸口的愧疚的眼泪。“再见了，花莲……”一年前，优介进入了四海道高中，离开了家乡和家人，寻求重新开始。他搬到了一间小公寓，靠打各种兼职支付房租。优介的性格可以形容为随和，有着机智的幽默感，有时愤世嫉俗、冷嘲热讽。新学年的开始标志着他新的旅程。与其他独特的人相遇后，他将面临十字路口和艰难的选择，这些选择可能不仅改变他自己的未来，也会改变他所接触到的人的未来。优介能否遵守三年前对妹妹许下的承诺，重拾他在过去失去的东西？
